The '''Open Sea''' was a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] largely devoid of [[Star/Legends|stars]] in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], a remote [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[ThonBoka]]&mdash;a sack-shaped [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], whose name could be translated as "StarCave"&mdash;and the lost [[Human/Legends|Human]] colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Renatasia III]], one of fourteen colonization projects sponsored by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Elsinoré den Tasia|Tasia]] of [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]] in [[3950 BBY]]. The [[Oswaft]] [[Species/Legends|species]] nested in the ThonBoka, with the entire Open Sea being their domain.<ref name="atlas" />

[[Freighter/Legends|Freighters]] that experienced a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] failure in the Open Sea could remain undiscovered for [[Time/Legends|centuries]]. By [[43 ABY]],<ref name="atlas" /> a few hulks had been discovered and put into use as cautionary examples in the [[Hosrel system/Legends|Hosrel system]].<ref name="atlas" />
